title: The extremal gap for scattered $q$-systems
summary: Two general estimates govern the rank of an $h$-scattered $q$-system: the scattered upper bound and the lower bound for systems maximal under inclusion. We determine exactly when they coincide. Besides $m=h+1$ and $m=h+2$, equality occurs precisely when $h$ is even, $m=h+3$, and $k\equiv h/2\pmod{h+1}$. We also prove rigidity in the first two cases: every extremal system is equivalent to either $\mathbb{F}_q^k$ or a direct sum of elementary Gabidulin systems and $\mathbb{F}_q$-directions.
